label: Ixazomib
intro: Ixazomib has dedicated renal and hepatic impairment studies, both independent of its population PK model (Gupta 2017), and the platform has checked that model against them (Simulation 3.2a).

observed.title: Ixazomib renal (Gupta, Br J Haematol 2016) and hepatic (Gupta, Br J Clin Pharmacol 2016) impairment studies

model.title: Gupta 2017 ixazomib population PK model (Clin Pharmacokinet 56:1355)

scope.title: Platform scope of the Gupta 2017 model
scope.extraction: Platform scope file written from locked results (not an extraction).

kidney.text: Unbound AUC0-last, severe renal impairment vs normal (geometric least-squares mean ratio, 90% CI), single 3 mg dose.
kidney.population: Relapsed/refractory MM (37 of 41) or solid tumours (4 of 41); severe RI n = 10 vs normal n = 15

kidney.text: Unbound AUC0-last, ESRD on haemodialysis vs normal (ratio, 90% CI).
Total AUC0-last, severe RI and ESRD combined vs normal (ratio, 90% CI).

kidney.value: Plasma protein binding about 99% in all groups. Haemodialysis clearance < 2 mL/min in all ESRD patients; pre- and post-dialyser concentrations similar (Fig. 4).

kidney.text: Label consequence, as reported by the study article (the product information itself is not extracted on the platform).
kidney.value: Reduced starting dose of 3 mg for severe renal impairment or ESRD requiring dialysis (article Discussion; NINLARO product information).

kidney.text: Population model: renal function was tested over this range and not retained.
kidney.value: None. The analysis population's Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance was median 86.8 mL/min, range 25.8-297 (Table 2).

kidney.text: The platform computes the model only for Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance in this range (mL/min); below it, the study groups above are shown instead.

liver.text: Dose-normalised total AUC0-last, moderate hepatic impairment vs normal (ratio, 90% CI); 2.3 mg vs 4 mg.
liver.population: Advanced solid tumours (no MM); moderate n = 10 vs normal n = 12

liver.text: Dose-normalised total AUC0-last, severe hepatic impairment vs normal (ratio, 90% CI); 1.5 mg vs 4 mg.
liver.population: Advanced solid tumours; severe n = 11 vs normal n = 12

liver.text: Dose-normalised unbound AUC0-last, moderate and severe combined vs normal (ratio, 90% CI).
Impairment categories used (NCI Organ Dysfunction Working Group).

value.normal: NCI-ODWG: total bilirubin and AST <= ULN
value.moderate: NCI-ODWG: total bilirubin > 1.5-3 x ULN, any AST
value.severe: NCI-ODWG: total bilirubin > 3 x ULN, any AST

liver.text: Label consequence, as reported by the study article (the product information itself is not extracted on the platform).
liver.value: Reduced starting dose of 3 mg for moderate or severe hepatic impairment (article Discussion; NINLARO product information).

liver.text: Population model: hepatic function covariates and their range; moderate and severe impairment were not in the analysis.
liver.value: None. Total bilirubin median 7 umol/L, range 1.71-39.3 (0.1-2.3 mg/dL); AST median 22 U/L, range 4-127 (Table 2). Patients with moderate or severe hepatic impairment were not in the analysis (they were studied separately).

liver.text: The platform computes the model only for total bilirubin up to this multiple of the upper limit of normal; above it, the study groups above are shown instead.

age.text: Population model: covariates tested and not retained (includes age, 23-91 years).
age.value: Age (23-91 years), race, sex, body weight (correlated with BSA; BSA chosen), mild or moderate renal impairment (creatinine clearance), mild hepatic impairment, smoking status, concomitant CYP-modulating drugs (Abstract; Results 3.2; Supplementary Tables 2-3 not reviewed).

age.text: Age range (years) inside the model scope.

body_size.text: Population model: body surface area is the only retained covariate, on the second peripheral volume (V4); exponent of the power function.

body_size.value: -37 and +46% at the 5th and 95th percentile (1.5 and 2.25 m2) on V4 relative to median BSA (1.87 m2)

body_size.text: Body weight was tested; BSA was retained instead (the two are correlated). Clearance has no body-size covariate.
body_size.value: Age (23-91 years), race, sex, body weight (correlated with BSA; BSA chosen), mild or moderate renal impairment (creatinine clearance), mild hepatic impairment, smoking status, concomitant CYP-modulating drugs (Abstract; Results 3.2; Supplementary Tables 2-3 not reviewed).

other_covariates.text: Sex, race, smoking and concomitant CYP-modulating drugs were tested and not retained.
other_covariates.value: Age (23-91 years), race, sex, body weight (correlated with BSA; BSA chosen), mild or moderate renal impairment (creatinine clearance), mild hepatic impairment, smoking status, concomitant CYP-modulating drugs (Abstract; Results 3.2; Supplementary Tables 2-3 not reviewed).

not_this: A research summary of sourced findings. Not dosing guidance; doses are quoted from the label only as the label states them.
